content: For target classifiers, we tune batch size, learning rate, number of layers, number of units, attention size (BiLSTM$+$A), filter sizes and dropout probability (CNN). For BERT, we use the default fine-tuning hyper-parameter values except for batch size, where we adjust based on memory consumption. Note that after the target classifiers are trained their weights are not updated when training or testing the attacking methods.
